directives: Consolidate repeated ticker coverage into one daily watch post per stock, merging earnings, news, and technicals
Limit market-cap top-20 posts to weekly or only when a notable reshuffle occurs, not daily
Draw resistance/support levels only from at least 2-3 touches; label single-touch levels as 'breakout target' not 'resistance'
Trim headlines to under 15 words, leading with the key number or move, and vary emoji usage
Add at least one non-earnings post per week (index, commodity, or macro) to balance the mix
